options.content:
Power Management System

Breakers, converters, switches and grids of the PMS, from the Marpower AMCS. Every section has a **Trends** tab with the history over the selected time range and a **Live** tab with the latest values. **Timelines** show each binary signal as on or off: red for alarms, green for status, blue for commands. **Live tables** use the same colors for signals that are on.

spec.title: AFT thruster main breakers
spec.description: F105 and F110 main breakers of the AFT thruster, from the DC distribution general table. Transitions only. Red: alarm, green: status, blue: command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "F105 Fault/trip", "F105 Open 1 (OF1)", "F105 Open 2 (OF2)", "F105 Open command", "F110 Fault/trip", "F110 Open 1 (OF1)", "F110 Open 2 (OF2)", "F110 Open command" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_fault__value AS INT) AS "F105 Fault/trip", LAG(CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_fault__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Fault/trip",
    CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_open__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open 1 (OF1)", LAG(CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open 1 (OF1)",
    CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_2_f_105_open__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open 2 (OF2)", LAG(CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_2_f_105_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open 2 (OF2)",
    CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_105_opencmd__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open command", LAG(CAST(keb_6_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_105_opencmd__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open command",
    CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_fault__value AS INT) AS "F110 Fault/trip", LAG(CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_fault__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Fault/trip",
    CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_open__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open 1 (OF1)", LAG(CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open 1 (OF1)",
    CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_2_f_110_open__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open 2 (OF2)", LAG(CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_2_f_110_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open 2 (OF2)",
    CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_opencmd__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open command", LAG(CAST(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_opencmd__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open command"
  FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution_general
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) t
WHERE ("prev F105 Fault/trip" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Fault/trip")
  OR ("prev F105 Open 1 (OF1)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open 1 (OF1)")
  OR ("prev F105 Open 2 (OF2)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open 2 (OF2)")
  OR ("prev F105 Open command" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open command")
  OR ("prev F110 Fault/trip" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Fault/trip")
  OR ("prev F110 Open 1 (OF1)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open 1 (OF1)")
  OR ("prev F110 Open 2 (OF2)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open 2 (OF2)")
  OR ("prev F110 Open command" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open command")
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Thruster main breakers
spec.description: The latest value within the last 5 minutes, independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: the time of the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT last_value(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_fault__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r0_0,
    last_value(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_1_f_105_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r0_1,
    last_value(keb_6_aft_thrust_main_break_of_2_f_105_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r0_2,
    last_value(keb_6_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_105_opencmd__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r0_3,
    last_value(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_fault__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r1_0,
    last_value(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r1_1,
    last_value(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_2_f_110_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r1_2,
    last_value(keb_7_aft_thrust_mainbreakof_1_f_110_opencmd__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS r1_3,

spec.title: Solar system 1
spec.description: Converter (keb7-sol1) and Bender isolation monitor. Transitions only. Red: alarm, green: status, blue: command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "Converter Temp. warning 1", "Converter Temp. warning 2", "Converter Status OK", "Converter Enable", "Converter Safety disconnect" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(tempwarn_1__value AS INT) AS "Converter Temp. warning 1", LAG(CAST(tempwarn_1__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Temp. warning 1",
    CAST(tempwarn_2__value AS INT) AS "Converter Temp. warning 2", LAG(CAST(tempwarn_2__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Temp. warning 2",
    CAST(statusok__value AS INT) AS "Converter Status OK", LAG(CAST(statusok__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Status OK",
    CAST(enabledisable__value AS INT) AS "Converter Enable", LAG(CAST(enabledisable__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Enable",
    CAST(safetydisconnect__value AS INT) AS "Converter Safety disconnect", LAG(CAST(safetydisconnect__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Safety disconnect"
  FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution__conv
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb7-sol1'
) t
WHERE ("prev Converter Temp. warning 1" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Temp. warning 1")
  OR ("prev Converter Temp. warning 2" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Temp. warning 2")
  OR ("prev Converter Status OK" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Status OK")
  OR ("prev Converter Enable" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Enable")
  OR ("prev Converter Safety disconnect" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Safety disconnect")
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, "Bender MF-DO output (M+)", "Bender DI/O output (Q)", "Bender Digital input (I)" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(keb_7_sol_1_bend_mplus__value AS INT) AS "Bender MF-DO output (M+)", LAG(CAST(keb_7_sol_1_bend_mplus__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Bender MF-DO output (M+)",

  OR ("prev Bender DI/O output (Q)" IS DISTINCT FROM "Bender DI/O output (Q)")
  OR ("prev Bender Digital input (I)" IS DISTINCT FROM "Bender Digital input (I)")

spec.title: Solar converters
spec.description: The latest value within the last 5 minutes, independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: the time of the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE topic WHEN 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb7-sol1' THEN 'Solar 1' WHEN 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb6-sol2-1' THEN 'Solar 2.1' WHEN 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb6-sol2-2' THEN 'Solar 2.2' END AS "Converter",
  CAST(last_value(tempwarn_1__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Temp. warning 1",
  CAST(last_value(tempwarn_2__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Temp. warning 2",
  CAST(last_value(statusok__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Status OK",
  CAST(last_value(enabledisable__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Enable",
  CAST(last_value(safetydisconnect__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Safety disconnect",
  max(timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution__conv
WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb7-sol1', 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb6-sol2-1', 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/conv/keb6-sol2-2')
GROUP BY topic ORDER BY 1

spec.title: DC switch 05.71
spec.description: Topic keb6-0571. Transitions only. Red: alarm, green: status, blue: command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "Tripped", "Opened", "Closed", "Running", "Open cmd", "Close cmd", "Reset cmd" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(tripped__value AS INT) AS "Tripped", LAG(CAST(tripped__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Tripped",
    CAST(opened__value AS INT) AS "Opened", LAG(CAST(opened__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Opened",

  FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution__dc_switch
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution/dc-switch/keb6-0571'
) t
